mapper.select: select g.id, g.exam_id, g.question_id, g.grader_id, u.nick_name as grader_name, u.user_name, d.dept_name, g.target_count, g.graded_count from biz_county_exam_grader g left join sys_user u on g.grader_id = u.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id where g.exam_id = #{examId} order by g.question_id asc, g.id asc
select id, exam_id, question_id, grader_id, target_count, graded_count from biz_county_exam_grader where exam_id = #{examId} and grader_id = #{graderId} order by id asc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into biz_county_exam_grader (exam_id, question_id, grader_id, target_count, graded_count) values (#{examId}, #{questionId}, #{graderId}, #{targetCount}, #{gradedCount})
